instruction:
You are a traffic-safety engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-01 intersection timing, grade, and sight-distance package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values below for numeric grading. MUTCD and AASHTO-style timing and sight-distance workflows shape the context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-01-LH-02`
- Intersection plan: `INT-SSC01-002`
- Vertical profile: `PROF-SSC01-002`
- Signal timing sheet: `SIG-SSC01-002`
- Pedestrian crossing case: `PED-SSC01-002`
- Safety memo: `MEMO-SSC01-002`
- Approach: `NB-APPROACH-02`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Approach speed | {{ approach_speed_kmh }} km/h |
| Approach grade | {{ approach_grade_pct }} % |
| Reaction time | {{ reaction_time_s }} s |
| Braking friction coefficient | {{ braking_friction_coefficient }} |
| Available sight distance | {{ available_sight_distance_m }} m |
| Yellow reaction time | {{ yellow_reaction_time_s }} s |
| Yellow deceleration | {{ yellow_deceleration_m_s2 }} m/s2 |
| Intersection width | {{ intersection_width_m }} m |
| Design vehicle length | {{ design_vehicle_length_m }} m |
| All-red speed | {{ all_red_speed_kmh }} km/h |
| Pedestrian startup time | {{ pedestrian_startup_time_s }} s |
| Crossing width | {{ crossing_width_m }} m |
| Pedestrian walk speed | {{ pedestrian_walk_speed_m_s }} m/s |
| Available pedestrian clearance | {{ pedestrian_clearance_available_s }} s |

## Required Calculations

- Convert speeds from km/h to m/s.
- Use grade as a signed decimal in the stopping-distance and yellow-interval checks.
- Braking distance is `v^2 / (2 x g x (friction + grade))`.
- Stopping distance is reaction distance plus braking distance.
- Sight-distance margin is available sight distance minus stopping distance.
- Yellow interval is `reaction + v / (2 x deceleration + 2 x g x grade)`.
- All-red interval is `(intersection width + vehicle length) / all-red speed`.
- Pedestrian clearance required is startup time plus crossing width divided by walk speed.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when sight distance and pedestrian clearance margins are non-negative.

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state that the baseline source pack passes the current synthetic checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable source-pack hardening, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "stopping_distance_m": <numeric_value>,
  "sight_distance_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "yellow_interval_s": <numeric_value>,
  "all_red_interval_s": <numeric_value>,
  "ped_clearance_required_s": <numeric_value>,
  "ped_clearance_margin_s": <numeric_value>,
  "grade_adjusted_braking_distance_m": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "intersection-timing-grade-sight-distance-package"
description = "SSC-01 intersection timing, grade, and sight-distance metrics"
long_description = "Calculates task-owned synthetic SSC-01 metrics for one intersection approach, including grade-adjusted stopping distance, sight-distance margin, yellow interval, all-red interval, and pedestrian clearance."
discipline = "civil"
category = "traffic-safety"
standards = ["FHWA MUTCD", "AASHTO Green Book"]
tags = ["civil", "road", "intersection", "signal", "sight-distance", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.approach_speed_kmh]
type = "float"
unit = "km/h"
description = "SIG-SSC01-002 approach design speed"
min = 60.0
max = 60.0

[params.approach_grade_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "PROF-SSC01-002 signed approach grade; downhill is negative"
min = -3.0
max = -3.0

[params.reaction_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "MEMO-SSC01-002 stopping sight-distance reaction time"
min = 2.5
max = 2.5

[params.braking_friction_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "MEMO-SSC01-002 braking friction coefficient"
min = 0.35
max = 0.35

[params.available_sight_distance_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "INT-SSC01-002 available approach sight distance"
min = 145.0
max = 145.0

[params.yellow_reaction_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "SIG-SSC01-002 yellow interval perception-reaction term"
min = 1.0
max = 1.0

[params.yellow_deceleration_m_s2]
type = "float"
unit = "m/s2"
description = "SIG-SSC01-002 comfortable deceleration rate for yellow timing"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.intersection_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "INT-SSC01-002 conflict area width"
min = 28.0
max = 28.0

[params.design_vehicle_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "MEMO-SSC01-002 design vehicle length"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.all_red_speed_kmh]
type = "float"
unit = "km/h"
description = "SIG-SSC01-002 clearance speed for all-red interval"
min = 50.0
max = 50.0

[params.pedestrian_startup_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "PED-SSC01-002 startup allowance"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.crossing_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PED-SSC01-002 crossing width"
min = 14.0
max = 14.0

[params.pedestrian_walk_speed_m_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m/s"
description = "PED-SSC01-002 pedestrian walk speed"
min = 1.2
max = 1.2

[params.pedestrian_clearance_available_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "SIG-SSC01-002 available pedestrian clearance interval"
min = 16.0
max = 16.0

[outputs.stopping_distance_m]
description = "Grade-adjusted stopping distance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.sight_distance_margin_m]
description = "Available sight distance minus stopping distance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.yellow_interval_s]
description = "Grade-adjusted yellow interval"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.all_red_interval_s]
description = "Intersection all-red clearance interval"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.ped_clearance_required_s]
description = "Required pedestrian clearance interval"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.ped_clearance_margin_s]
description = "Available pedestrian clearance minus required clearance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.grade_adjusted_braking_distance_m]
description = "Braking distance component of stopping distance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when the synthetic sight-distance and clearance checks pass"
tolerance = 0.01

[archetypes.ssc01_intersection_timing]
description = "SSC-01 task-owned synthetic intersection timing and sight-distance package"
site_contexts = ["intersection-approach-grade-signal-clearance"]

[difficulty.easy]

visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc01_intersection_timing"]

visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc01_intersection_timing"]
